Settings

🔀 Teaching mode

LexiGo is currently in Kids mode. You can switch modes anytime.

🔑 AI import key

Powers the "Clean with AI" button when importing vocabulary lists. Get a key from console.anthropic.com.

🔐 Not set

💾 Backup & restore

Your data lives in this browser only. If the cache gets cleared, it's gone — so download a backup file now and then, and keep it somewhere safe (Google Drive, email to yourself, etc).

📱 Telegram Bot Settings

The secure way to connect Telegram: every teacher points LexiGo at their own Report Server (a small backend that holds the actual bot token — see the smart-education-telegram-reports project). LexiGo only ever stores this scoped API key, never the bot token itself. Once set, roster changes and finished quizzes sync automatically, and reports can be sent on demand from any class's Progress page. In the target Telegram group, an admin runs /setup <Class name> once to link that group.

🔐

⚠️ Advanced: no report server? Paste a bot token directly (not recommended)

This is the fallback for a teacher with no report server. Create a bot with @BotFather, paste its token below, then add that same bot to your Telegram group. Unlike the option above, the token itself is saved in this browser's storage — never in the app's source code or any repository, but visible to anyone with access to this device's browser tools. Prefer the Report Server option above when you can.

📊 Class Insights

Clear class history saves a snapshot first (recoverable below in History & Rewind).

⚠️ Danger zone

Reset All permanently deletes every result, score history and battle record for this group. Unlike "Clear class history" above, this does not create a recoverable snapshot — it cannot be undone. Students, vocabulary, Units and group settings are not affected.

Every time you clear history, a snapshot is saved here. View any snapshot, or rewind to bring it back as the live data (today's data gets snapshotted first, so it's never lost).

📤 To share a daily report, open the group and use Share Report. Telegram opens for the teacher to choose the correct group and send the prepared report.

Pick your AI tool below — the prompt is copied automatically and the tool opens in a new tab. Just paste it in (Ctrl/Cmd+V), attach your lesson material, then paste the JSON it gives back below. You can also upload a vocabulary file exported by another teacher — it will be added to this unit.

In Teens/Adult mode these buttons use the enhanced prompt — pronunciation, Uzbek meaning with an emoji, easy/normal/hard examples, two collocations and a synonym — and the JSON it returns imports here automatically.

ⓘ Messy lists are fine — mixed separators (-, —, :, (), =), childish pronunciation, missing translations. Click 🤖 Clean with AI to have Claude sort it out, or upload a .txt, .csv, .pdf or .docx file to have it cleaned automatically. Written pronunciation is always removed (use the audio button instead). Set your AI key once in ⚙️ Settings (Home menu).
Quick preview also understands:
• word, translation  e.g. Apple, Olma
• emoji, word, translation  e.g. 🍎, Apple, Olma
• Plain word only (translation left blank)

✨ Generate Multiple Units
1 Add your vocabulary lists

Paste several lists in one go — start each unit with a name line (e.g. Unit 5 - Animals or ## Food), then its words. Or upload files/a whole folder (.txt, .csv, .md, .pdf, .docx or .json): every file becomes its own unit, named after the file.

2 Generate with your AI tool

One tap opens the tool with the ready prompt and all your lists inside it (ChatGPT auto-fills; the others get it on your clipboard — just paste and send).

3 Bring the AI’s JSON reply back — everything is created here
